services.desc: Special!Book a Massage today and receive a complimentary all-day pass to our hot spring pools. Please note the day pass is only valid on the same day of your massage reservation. We do not offer Prenatal Massages or Couples Massages. To book massages, guest must be 18 years or older. The Swedish massage is the best known and most widely practiced type of massage therapy. There are a variety of techniques used including circular pressure applied by the hands and palms, kneading, light tapping, and more.
